text_en: Then Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and summoned the elders, the heads, the judges, and the officers of Israel; and they presented themselves before God.
text_cn: 若苏厄又聚集以色列众支派来到舍根，也召集了以色列的长老、首领、判官和官长，叫他们立在天主面前，

text_en: And Joshua said to all the people, “Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Long ago your ancestors—Terah and his sons Abraham and Nahor—lived beyond the Euphrates and served other gods.
text_cn: 若苏厄对全民众说：“上主以色列的天主这样说：从前你们的祖先亚巴郎和纳曷尔的父亲特辣黑，住在大河那边，事奉别的神明。

text_en: Then I took your father Abraham from beyond the River and led him through all the land of Canaan and made his offspring many. I gave him Isaac;
text_cn: 我将你们的祖先亚巴郎从大河那边召来，领他走遍客纳罕全地，使他的后裔繁多，赐给了他依撒格。

text_en: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Seir to possess, but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.
text_cn: 我又将雅各伯和厄撒乌，赐给了依撒格；将色依尔山区赐给了厄撒乌作产业；雅各伯却和他的儿子下到了埃及。

text_en: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt with what I did in its midst; and afterwards I brought you out.
text_cn: 以后，我派了梅瑟和亚郎，在埃及行奇迹，打击了埃及，然后将你们领了出来。

text_en: When I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, you came to the sea; and the Egyptians pursued your ancestors with chariots and horsemen to the Red Sea.
text_cn: 当我领你们的祖先离开埃及来到海边时，埃及人率领车辆兵马，追赶你们的祖先直到红海。

text_en: When they cried out to the Lord , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and made the sea come upon them and cover them; and your eyes saw what I did to Egypt. Afterwards you lived in the wilderness a long time.
text_cn: 当他们呼求上主时，上主便在你们与埃及人之间突降浓雾，使海水流回淹没了他们。我在埃及所行的，你们都亲眼见过。以后，你们在旷野住了很久。

text_en: Then I brought you to the land of the Amorites, who lived on the other side of the Jordan; they fought with you, and I handed them over to you, and you took possession of their land, and I destroyed them before you.
text_cn: 当我领你们到了住在约但河东阿摩黎人的地域时，他们曾攻击过你们，但我将他们交在你们手中，使你们占领了他们的地方，由你们面前消灭了他们。

text_en: Then King Balak son of Zippor of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent and invited Balaam son of Beor to curse you,
text_cn: 那时，摩阿布王，漆颇尔的儿子巴拉克起来攻击以色列，并派人叫贝敖尔的儿子巴郎来诅咒你们。

text_en: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you; so I rescued you out of his hand.
text_cn: 但是我不想俯听巴郎，他反而祝福了你们。这样，我从他手中救了你们。

text_en: When you went over the Jordan and came to Jericho, the citizens of Jericho fought against you, and also the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I handed them over to you.
text_cn: 此后你们渡过约但河，来到耶里哥，耶里哥的居民同你们作战，以后有阿摩黎人、培黎齐人、客纳罕人、赫特人、基尔加士人、希威人和耶步斯人，都同你们作过战，但我将他们都交在你们手中。

text_en: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove out before you the two kings of the Amorites; it was not by your sword or by your bow.
text_cn: 我并派黄蜂在你们前，将阿摩黎人的两个王子，从你们面前赶走，并未用你们的剑，也未用你们的弓。

text_en: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and towns that you had not built, and you live in them; you eat the fruit of vineyards and oliveyards that you did not plant.
text_cn: 这样，我把未经你们开垦的地，赐给了你们；把未经你们建筑的城，赐给了你们居住；将未经你们种植的萄葡园和橄榄树林，赐给了你们作食物。

text_en: “Now therefore revere the Lord , and serve him in sincerity and in faithfulness; put away the gods that your ancestors served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .
text_cn: 所以你们应该敬畏上主，诚心敬意地事奉他，抛弃你们祖先在大河那边和埃及所事奉的神，惟独事奉上主。

text_en: Now if you are unwilling to serve the Lord , choose this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served in the region beyond the River or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living; but as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord . ”
text_cn: 若是你们不乐意事奉上主，那么今天就选择你们所愿事奉的，或是你们祖先在大河那边事奉的神，或是你们现住地的阿摩黎人的神；至于我和我的家族，我们一定要事奉上主。”

text_en: Then the people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake the Lord to serve other gods;
text_cn: 百姓回答说：“我们绝对不愿背弃上主，去事奉其他的神！

text_en: for it is the Lord our God who brought us and our ancestors up from the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and who did those great signs in our sight. He protected us along all the way that we went, and among all the peoples through whom we passed;
text_cn: 因为上主是我们的天主，是他领我们和我们的祖先出离了埃及地，为奴之家，在我们眼前行了那些绝大的神迹，在我们所走的一切路上，在我们所经过的一切民族中，始终保护了我们。

text_en: and the Lord drove out before us all the peoples, the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the Lord , for he is our God. ”
text_cn: 上主更从我们面前，赶走了所有的异族，和住在这地的阿摩黎人。为此，我们必要事奉上主，因为他是我们的天主。”

text_en: But Joshua said to the people, “You cannot serve the Lord , for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions or your sins.
text_cn: 若苏厄对百姓说：“你们不能事奉上主，因为他是神圣不可侵犯的天主，是忌邪的天主，他决不宽赦你们的过犯和罪恶，

text_en: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you harm, and consume you, after having done you good. ”
text_cn: 如果你们背弃上主，去事奉外邦的神，在他恩待你们之后，他必转而向你们降祸，消灭你们。”

text_en: And the people said to Joshua, “No, we will serve the Lord ! ”
text_cn: 百姓答复若苏厄说：“决不！我们一定要事奉上主！”

text_en: Then Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the Lord , to serve him. ” And they said, “We are witnesses. ”
text_cn: 若苏厄对百姓说：“这是你们对自己作证，要选择事奉上主！”他们答说：“我们自己作证。”

text_en: He said, “Then put away the foreign gods that are among you, and incline your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel. ”
text_cn: “那么，你们应除掉你们中间的外邦神，一心归向上主，以色列的天主。”

text_en: The people said to Joshua, “The Lord our God we will serve, and him we will obey. ”
text_cn: 百姓答复若苏厄说：“我们必定事奉上主，我们的天主，必听从他的声音。”

text_en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made statutes and ordinances for them at Shechem.
text_cn: 当天，若苏厄便与百姓立约，在舍根为他们立定了诫命和典章。

text_en: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a large stone, and set it up there under the oak in the sanctuary of the Lord .
text_cn: 若苏厄将这些话都写在天主的法律书上；又取了一块大石，立在上主圣所旁边的笃(dǔ)耨(nòu)香树下。

text_en: Joshua said to all the people, “See, this stone shall be a witness against us; for it has heard all the words of the Lord that he spoke to us; therefore it shall be a witness against you, if you deal falsely with your God. ”
text_cn: 若苏厄对全民众说：“看！这块石头将作我们的见证，因为这块石头听见了上主对我们所说的一切话。这块石头也将作你们的见证，以免你们背弃你们的天主。”

text_en: So Joshua sent the people away to their inheritances.
text_cn: 此后，若苏厄便打发百姓各自回到自己的地业去了。

text_en: After these things Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died, being one hundred ten years old.
text_cn: 这些事以后，上主的仆人，农的儿子若苏厄便去了世，享年一百一十岁。

text_en: They buried him in his own inheritance at Timnath-serah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
text_cn: 人将他埋葬在加阿士山北，厄弗辣因山区的提默纳特色辣黑自己的产业内。

text_en: Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua and had known all the work that the Lord did for Israel.
text_cn: 若苏厄在世时以及在他死后，那些知道上主为以色列所行的一切事迹的长老们在世时，以色列人常事奉了上主。

text_en: The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the portion of ground that Jacob had bought from the children of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for one hundred pieces of money; it became an inheritance of the descendants of Joseph.
text_cn: 以色列子民也将从埃及抬回来的若瑟的遗骸，埋葬在舍根的田里。那块田是雅各伯用一百银钱，由舍根的父亲，哈摩尔的子孙手中买来的；这块田便成了若瑟子孙的产业。

text_en: Eleazar son of Aaron died; and they buried him at Gibeah, the town of his son Phinehas, which had been given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
text_cn: 亚郎的儿子厄肋阿匝尔也死了。人将他埋葬在基贝亚，即他的儿子丕乃哈斯在厄弗辣因山地分得的城内。
